subject.title: fix(reef): contain startup friend reconcile failures

question: Should Reef continue startup with persisted peer keys after a retryable relay reconciliation failure, rather than fail the account and rely on supervisor restart?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and tested, but it deliberately changes the product safety boundary from fail-start to temporary key staleness for several transient relay and transport failures.

options.title: Confirm persisted-key fallback
options.body: Accept continued availability during retryable startup failures, relying on the next reconciliation interval to refresh peer keys.

options.title: Keep startup fail-closed
options.body: Require a successful startup reconciliation and reject the PR's continuation path if fresh peer keys are mandatory before any account activity.

options.title: Narrow the retryable set
options.body: Permit only specifically approved transient failures, such as relay throttling, and retain fail-start behavior for the remaining retryable transport classes.

recommendation.title: Confirm persisted-key fallback
recommendation.body: Accept continued availability during retryable startup failures, relying on the next reconciliation interval to refresh peer keys.
